punchline: Yin started using Instagram because a friend recommended it; she keeps opening it because she's afraid of losing a moment.
thirty_sec: Nir Eyal describes Yin, a Stanford student who posts dozens of Instagram photos a day and swears she has no problem. It started with a friend's tip, then the icon and the notifications. Weeks later she didn't need any of those. The fear of a moment slipping away was enough to make her open the app. That move from outside cue to inside feeling, Eyal says, is when a habit sets.
